donors.head: 3757c4f5
donors.destination: Composite criteria CI-005, CI-012, CI-013, and CI-014
donors.boundary: Do not copy large social ledgers already represented by L.
donors.risk: A second population ledger could drift from the canonical corpus fixtures.
donors.verification: npm run evals:composite-integration && npm run evals:blind-spots

donors.head: 67fc3042
donors.mechanism: Separate governance concerns and statement-level semantic safety
donors.destination: Composite criteria CI-003, CI-006, and CI-007
donors.boundary: Retain L's command names and avoid a second lifecycle schema.
donors.risk: Parallel lifecycle terms would make maturity and publication status ambiguous.
donors.verification: npm run check:composite-integration && npm run public-safety

donors.head: ff440a9c
donors.destination: Composite criterion CI-014 and human-gate reporting
donors.boundary: A diagnostic pass does not close external or human work.
donors.risk: Automation could falsely certify reader, collaborator, or accessibility evidence.
donors.verification: npm run evals:composite-integration && npm run evals:release-governance

donors.head: 5a7095ff
donors.mechanism: Versioned rubric and inspectable observation history
donors.destination: Composite rubric versioning and run records
donors.boundary: Do not copy redundant screenshot sets or twenty-three rubric directories.
donors.risk: Redundant rubrics and images would increase review cost without stronger evidence.
donors.verification: npm run test:composite-integration && npm run check:composite-integration

donors.head: d7d8e0d0
donors.mechanism: Atomic proposition, source limitation, correction, and disposition semantics
donors.destination: L's canonical schema plus criteria CI-004 and CI-008
donors.boundary: Preserve L's simpler record model unless a new field changes a decision.
donors.risk: Schema expansion could duplicate sources and obscure correction lineage.
donors.verification: npm run test:knowledge-lifecycle && npm run evals:knowledge-lifecycle

donors.head: ba746185
donors.mechanism: Anti-gaming, production verification, rollback, and stopping rules
donors.destination: Composite criterion CI-014 and release documentation
donors.boundary: Application sharing must not wait for unlimited archive expansion.
donors.risk: Production evidence and application eligibility could collapse into one endless gate.
donors.verification: npm run preflight:staging && npm run preflight:production

donors.head: d97055d7
donors.mechanism: Candidate fingerprint, failed-run retention, and unchanged-candidate holdouts
donors.destination: Composite scorecards and recursive stop condition
donors.boundary: Holdout artifacts are evidence of the evaluated candidate, not external hiring outcomes.
donors.risk: A run artifact could change the candidate it claims to evaluate or reuse a dirty tree.
donors.verification: npm run test:composite-integration && npm run evals:composite-integration

donors.head: 934c1bdf
donors.mechanism: Article-level close reading and institutional agency modeling
donors.boundary: Campaign press indexes remain distinct from article-level support.
donors.risk: Index inclusion could be mistaken for article-level role or outcome evidence.
donors.verification: npm run check:citations && npm run evals:knowledge-lifecycle

donors.head: 793f7262
donors.destination: docs/knowledge-bank/policies and criteria CI-006 and CI-007
donors.boundary: Regression tests must not contain the protected details they exclude.
donors.risk: Unknown projects or routes could silently inherit inappropriate credit or evidence.
donors.verification: npm run test:composite-integration && npm run public-safety

donors.head: 7e1b758b
donors.mechanism: Conservative incubation, contextual integrity, and explicit stop records
donors.destination: Composite run history and held/rejected donor decisions
donors.boundary: Knowledge maturity does not require website publication.
donors.risk: Mature but irrelevant material could overload the hiring argument.
donors.verification: npm run check:composite-integration && npm run evals:chad

donors.head: 5b0cbcd1
donors.mechanism: Append-only intake, query tools, and route-specific manifests
donors.boundary: Human approval remains explicit; broad defensibility cannot authorize every route.
donors.risk: Convenient tools could write private leads or authorize projections implicitly.
donors.verification: npm run test:knowledge-tools && npm run test:composite-integration

donors.head: 68846b1f
donors.boundary: Do not replace the spine with a donor-specific parallel system.
donors.risk: A replacement vocabulary would split source, claim, and projection ownership.
donors.verification: npm run test:knowledge-lifecycle && npm run check:composite-integration

donors.head: 289dd449
donors.mechanism: Application-ready stopping rule, CI posture, and archive-to-composition discipline
donors.destination: Composite criteria CI-012, CI-014, and CI-015
donors.boundary: Current-practice language must not imply unproven client adoption.
donors.risk: Archive completeness could delay applications or inflate present-tense adoption claims.
donors.verification: npm run evals:hiring-comprehension && npm run evals:present-tense-offer

donors.head: 10d20ecd
donors.mechanism: Cross-surface claim consistency and flagship reader hierarchy
donors.boundary: Do not copy every donor page change without a demonstrated reader need.
donors.risk: Cross-surface consistency work could flatten purposeful differences between routes.
donors.verification: npm run check:routes && npm run evals:composite-integration
